comment: Upstream-owned files whose fork text stays in the tracked tree on purpose.
This list is a temporary record of the last upstream-owned deltas. The
fork's goal is zero touching of stock files: every path here is meant to
leave the list as the fork's own workflow and script copies take over.
The release gate compares the tracked tree against the pinned upstream
base and refuses to release when a path drifts that is not on this list.
